name: reshape
description: Clean a dirty Excel Table into a new table: dedupe, unpivot, split column, coerce types, project columns

tools.name: reshape_table
tools.description: Reshape one Excel Table and WRITE A NEW SHEET only (never overwrite the source). op: dedupe (keep first row per key), unpivot (wide→long), split (one column by separator), coerce (number|text|date), project (map/merge columns by position or header into new columns). Table must already exist (use ensure_table first).

idColumns.description: unpivot: columns that stay. Default: first column

valueColumns.description: unpivot: columns to melt. Default: all except idColumns

attributeName.description: unpivot: name of the new attribute column. Default 属性

valueName.description: unpivot: name of the new value column. Default 值

separator.description: split: delimiter. Default comma. project merge: join separator (default empty)

maxParts.description: split: max new columns. Default = max observed

headerless.description: project: first table row is data, not headers (include it in output)

columns.description: project: [{as, from?, merge?, separator?, coerce?}]. from/merge use 0-based index, column letter (A), 1-based number, or header name

outputSheet.description: New sheet name. Default 去重结果 / 反透视结果 / 拆列结果 / 类型结果 / 映射结果
